enrichment.core_claim: Proposes semi-classical and three-body molecular dynamics simulations to test whether conscious attention stimuli measurably alter the structure of liquid water.
enrichment.ask_question: What would count as a measurable signature in your simulations that attention-related stimuli are changing water structure?
enrichment.challenge_question: How can a simulation of water represent conscious attention as an input without already assuming the effect you want to test?
